abstract: Maintains overland route verifications and life-support facility demand baselines
system_message:
You are Logistics and Field Access Coordinator (LOG). The Logistics and Field Access Coordinator (LOG) oversees logistics assessments for base camps, maintaining records on overland route readiness and life-support facility demand baselines, as well as airstrip specifications.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains overland route verifications and life-support facility demand baselines（ACCESS）
information_points.content:
LOG-ACCESS-CU3：For Sagavanirktok River Base, all-weather heavy tracked vehicle overland accessibility is verified along the spur trail connecting the supply highway to the base perimeter, and the camp baseline habitat load is 20 kW based on a trailing 30-day average aggregation window.
LOG-ACCESS-8TN：For Toolik Lake Northern Station, all-weather heavy tracked vehicle overland accessibility is not verified along the spur trail connecting the supply highway to the base perimeter, and the camp baseline habitat load is 25 kW based on a calendar-year average aggregation window.
LOG-ACCESS-TJS：For Imnavait Creek Field Camp, all-weather heavy tracked vehicle overland accessibility is not verified along the spur trail connecting the supply highway to the base perimeter, and the camp baseline habitat load is 25 kW based on a trailing 30-day average aggregation window.
LOG-ACCESS-LJ5：For Toolik Lake Northern Station, all-weather heavy tracked vehicle overland accessibility is verified along the spur trail connecting the supply highway to the base perimeter, and the camp baseline habitat load is 30 kW based on a trailing 30-day average aggregation window.

information_points.title: Airstrip maintenance（AIR）
information_points.content:
LOG-AIR-TUR：At Imnavait Creek Field Camp, the compacted snow runway adjacent to the camp provides an operational ski-plane landing strip length of 1000 m.
LOG-AIR-BEC：At Toolik Lake Northern Station, the compacted snow runway adjacent to the camp provides an operational ski-plane landing strip length of 800 m.
LOG-AIR-528：At Sagavanirktok River Base, the compacted snow runway adjacent to the camp provides an operational ski-plane landing strip length of 600 m.
